handoff: Production boost is built, not run through the suite. API: main.boost (game/boost.gd): charges(), can_boost(planet_index)->{ok,reason}, use_boost(planet_index)->{ok,reason}, is_boosted(planet_index), boosted_count(), grant(source). Engine: RouteEngine.buy_amount(planet, good) is the boosted Buy amount (local_amount stays the unboosted/Sell one); Storage.capacity_of raises boosted keys by boost_storage_pct. Atoms boost_charge, boost_used:<planet>, boost_used_any; availability feature production_boost. Skills MIN_16 and BIO_16 (tier 4, effect boost_charge, no key). EV97 (SIGN: charge + boost_event_fee, LAPSE) and EV98 (ACCEPT: charge + attar down at planet_1, DECLINE) are rows in data/chains.json pool_new; choices take an 'extra' effect list. Events.note_ready/forced_id force them after boost_event_force_cycles. GIG03 option A gives boost_charge, idle gig_idle_boost, weight_key gig_weight_boost. Notices posted from Boost via StoryText.get_or. Test: _test_boost in run_tests.gd.
